correctness_before_counter_assertion: Original unique creation IDs and contiguous accepted positions
Zero selected enrollments and all original producers remain active during the held sync
Same three/four entry persistence total before peer delivery
Production apply on all voters, each original creation and pinned SQL value/version
Exact accepted position/digest replay without reinitialization or rejection
One initializer per cell, zero retained producer operation/byte credits after release
Joined pool/runtime/engine/domain close before the persistence-call assertion
owning_oracle.interpretation: Successful leader proposal persistence calls before peer delivery, excluding later commit/apply persistence; not a hardware flush count, throughput or latency percentile. Repeated focused invocations are not added to full-suite distinct test counts.
